records.source_statement: The source asks which of two spouses would live longer.
limitations: Old claimed mortality reading; no observation verified.

records.source_statement: The first and seventh rulers are compared by strength, house and affliction to judge duration.
For the seventh-house partner the radical second is their turned eighth, so it serves as source death-house ruler.
limitations: Do not use radical eighth for both partners.

records.source_statement: A subsequent historical subsection asks about alleged sexual virtue, framed by ascendant lord, Moon and Venus.
limitations: Period morality classification, not a valid contemporary assessment.
